observations.body: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Wilderness, dry land, blossom, water, and a highway form a scene of reversal.
observations.label: Land and bodies restored

observations.body: Water, blossom, healing, courage, and a highway transform the wilderness scene together.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 35:1–8 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The vision promises passage and renewal while retaining boundaries around the holy way.
payload.title: The desert rejoices
